posts.text: If anyone has a good tacos recipe that does not need a stand mixer, please share. Measured 87 mm of rain overnight, the garden is very happy. Thinking about how much I enjoy slow mornings with tacos and no notifications. Reading A Psalm for the Wild-Built again and it hits differently this year. The crow next door learned to open our gate. We are negotiating. Sketched the city archive during lunch, still learning how to draw bicycles. My hedgehog has decided the keyboard is the warmest spot in the house. Spent the whole morning at the train station and saw 76 herons.
